method: scripts/audit/make-dock-over-tiles.mjs: the brightest thumbnail of the set under each dock label and icon, WCAG contrast of the label's own ink read from a photograph with its text hidden; the foot picture with and without the dock
notes: R56.4b replaces the measurement of R56.4: that one put one thumbnail, ranked by its mean over the whole picture, once under each label, centred, and found 4.73 at 0.58 for 1440 by 900. It was a single placement. The new run ranks the thumbnails by their brightest 160 by 112 px window at tile scale, puts the top three under every label at the window and at the blurred peak, the brightest one at a grid of nine places for the least readable labels, real ring tiles with their neighbours, finer places round the worst, and finds 4.27 at 390 by 844 and 4.42 at 320 by 568 at 0.58: not enough. The tint is therefore 0.61.

The blurred peak (the brightest point of the picture blurred with the glass 40 px blur, put under the middle of the label) is the worst place at the two phone sizes; at 1440 by 900 a real ring tile with its neighbours, a little off the peak, is the worst.

ringAll (every neighbour the brightest thumbnail) gives the same worst as ring to two decimals at every size, so the neighbours of the ring tile add nothing at the places a ring can put it (the tile's own picture is the brightest in its ring).

The foot check now has a bottom side and gates on every side a ring can reach (390 by 844: no ring tile passes below the dock; 320 by 568: none reaches half of the top edge), and the control with the old drop shadow put back fails everywhere it should.

summary.rule: the lowest step of 0.01 at which every label and icon keeps 4.5 to 1 or more with the worst tile of the set under it, at all three sizes

390x844.bottom: not reachable here (no ring tile covers half of the edge at any phase: best 0)

320x568.top: not reachable here (no ring tile covers half of the edge at any phase: best 0.326)

sides.bottom: not reachable here (no ring tile covers half of the edge at any phase: best 0)

sides.top: not reachable here (no ring tile covers half of the edge at any phase: best 0.326)

refine.label: refinement at 0.58: the worst cases of the first run moved in steps of 0.05 of the tile
